LanguageData.Purple_Aphrodisiac_Nanofluid.label: Purple Aphrodisiac Nanofluid
LanguageData.Purple_Aphrodisiac_Nanofluid.description: A purple liquid containing suspended, active purple nanomachines that strongly arouse desire. It is also the raw material for a concentrated preparation.
LanguageData.Purple_Aphrodisiac_Nanofluid_Plus.label: Concentrated Purple Aphrodisiac Nanofluid
LanguageData.Purple_Aphrodisiac_Nanofluid_Plus.descri: A concentrate made by evaporating excess liquid under reduced pressure. More purple nanomachines in each unit of volume make its effects stronger and faster. In an ordinary body, excessive consumption can cause repeated orgasms ending in unconsciousness.
